info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary:
projection reports which console apps the CALLER's org may open, and the plan
tier that decided it.
get.description:
projection reports which console apps the CALLER's org may open, and the plan
tier that decided it. It reads the billing truth (commerce entitlement), not
the org's own enablement toggles, and reports an app LOCKED when commerce
cannot answer — the read fails safe-to-locked rather than 500.

get.summary: get lists the products the org has turned on.
get.description:
get lists the products the org has turned on. The list is the org's own
INTENT (the enablement store), not what its plan grants — GET /v1/entitlements
answers that.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description:
Org is the org whose entitlements are read. It must be the caller's own
validated org unless the caller is a platform SuperAdmin, who may name any.

post.summary: post turns products on and off for one org.
post.description:
post turns products on and off for one org. Enabling requires the product to
be an active entitlement of the org's plan (a SuperAdmin bypasses that gate);
disabling is never gated. Add and remove are applied in one transaction and
the full resulting set is returned.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description:
Org is the org whose entitlements are written. It must be the caller's own
validated org unless the caller is a platform SuperAdmin, who may name any.

enabled.description:
Enabled is the sorted list of canonical product ids the org has turned on,
empty (never null) when it has turned none on.

add.description:
Add lists product ids to turn ON. Each must already be an ACTIVE
entitlement of the org's plan in commerce, unless the caller is a
SuperAdmin; anything else is refused with 402.

org.description:
Org is the org whose entitlements are written. It must be the caller's own
validated org unless the caller is a platform SuperAdmin, who may name any.

remove.description:
Remove lists product ids to turn OFF. Never gated — disabling a product is
always allowed.

apps.description:
Apps maps each console app (studio, bot, world, platform, team, admin) to
whether this caller may open it. Always all six keys, never null.

tier.description:
Tier is the plan slug commerce resolved for the org, "" when it holds no
active licensing subscription.
